issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be public for testing, but both the template and the solution implement this method as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement appears to mark singFarmSongVerse as private, creating an internal contradiction between the UML and the textual instruction. This mismatch will confuse students and may cause tests that expect a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) consistent with the problem text by declaring it public in Farm.java (both template and solution). Also update the UML in problem_statement.md to reflect the same visibility (public) or adjust the textual instruction to match the UML, so the specification is unambiguous for students.
